stem: Many factors affect the rate of cellular respiration.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Pyruvate carboxylase (PC) deficiency is a rare disease. The rate of respiration in the cells of a person with PC deficiency is much lower than normal.

The passage describes the occurrence of PC deficiency in human populations.

Complete the passage by using the most appropriate scientific terms.
